summary: NORTH frames 1 and 5 repeat the screen-right trailing/sole-toward-viewer arrangement; frame 5 does not demonstrate the expected opposite contact. Frames 3/7 read as rear/sole-visible lifts instead of distinct passes.

NORTHEAST frames 1 and 5 repeat the near-leg trailing toward viewer and forward near-arm arrangement. Frames 3/7 project the near foot toward viewer instead of passing; frames 4/8 raise the same far-side knee. Counter-swing remains unclear.

EAST frames 1 and 5 both lead with the screen-right/near thigh; frames 4 and 8 both raise the screen-right/front knee. Frames 3/7 do not show distinct passing legs; down poses and arm/leg counter-swing need review.

SOUTHEAST frames 1/5 repeat a foreground leg reaching toward viewer; frames 3/7 do not pass beneath the pelvis; frames 4/8 repeat the screen-right raised knee. Perspective obscures exact support side.

SOUTH frame 4 raises screen-right/character-left although right-up expects screen-left/character-right; frame 8 raises screen-left/character-right although left-up expects screen-right/character-left. Frames 4/8 are swap candidates, with arm swing still requiring review.
